name: Member and access management
description: The system must support member profiles, membership tiers, access periods, and restrictions so only valid members can check in and use facilities.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about member data or access rules.
Developer asks who can check in members or manage access.
Developer mentions membership plans or expiry rules.

name: Class scheduling and attendance tracking
description: The gym needs a clear way to schedule classes, track attendance, and manage capacity or instructor assignments.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about classes or bookings.
Developer mentions attendance or class capacity.
Developer discusses trainer assignment or scheduling complexity.

name: Equipment and facility usage
description: The system must track facility usage, equipment booking, and maintenance requirements so operations remain safe and smooth.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about equipment booking or maintenance.
Developer mentions facility access or usage limits.
Developer discusses operational safety or upkeep.

name: Billing, renewals, and payment handling
description: The system must support memberships, recurring payments, cancellations, freezes, and payment reconciliation without manual errors.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about recurring payments or billing cycles.
Developer mentions renewals, freezes, or failed payments.
Developer asks how sales and refunds are reconciled.

name: Check-in and facility access workflows
description: The business needs fast member check-in, restricted access, and clear records of who used which facilities or classes at what time.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about check-in workflows or access control.
Developer mentions member attendance records.
Developer discusses restrictions or front-desk visibility.

name: Reporting and performance dashboards
description: The gym needs membership, attendance, retention, and revenue reporting so management can understand churn, usage, and operational performance.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards, retention, or attendance reports.
Developer mentions revenue or member trends.
Developer discusses management visibility across the business.

name: Marketing and retention workflows
description: The business may need promotions, referral tracking, and reminder workflows to maintain member engagement and reduce churn.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about referral tracking or retention campaigns.
Developer mentions reminders or membership promotions.
Developer discusses keeping members engaged.

name: Staff coordination and operational realities
description: The solution must fit the realities of front-desk staff, trainers, and busy check-in periods while keeping onboarding and day-to-day use simple.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about staff roles or front-desk operations.
Developer mentions low training burden or busy periods.
Developer discusses operational constraints such as peak-time pressure.

name: Integration needs with payment and CRM tools
description: The business may need to connect with payment vendors, email tools, or existing systems to avoid duplicate work and manual reconciliation.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about existing software or external tools.
Developer mentions syncing payments or member data.
Developer discusses automation with CRM or communication tools.
